messages:
Maria: FYI — PineForge (Tier B) flagged: 68% drop in active API calls over last 28d vs prior period. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Customer PM mentioned evaluating a self-hosted pilot with a competitor. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/customers/pineforge/usage :eyes:
Raj: Ugh. Do we have top endpoints + error rates? Is this a product issue or just less traffic?
Maria: Top endpoints shifted — generation calls down 72%, embedding calls steady. No spike in 5xx. Alex (customer) said their new ML PM is running a cost/latency swimlane.
Evan: Pulled logs and ran quick query:
```
SELECT day, endpoint, count(*) as calls, avg(tokens) as avg_tokens
FROM pineforge_requests
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '28 days'
GROUP BY day, endpoint
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 7;
```
Evan: Results show avg_tokens per generate call dropped 80% -> they might be trimming prompts. No increased errors or auth failures.
Priya: If they're trimming prompts, they might be optimizing for cost. Comp vendor offering on-prem price comparison could be selling TCO. Suggest offering 30-day Dedicated trial + security pack to match procurement asks. I can own the technical PoC.
Daniel: I'll reach out to Alex to confirm timeline and who else is on procurement. Can someone prep a tailored cost delta (hosted vs dedicated vs self-host) and a short one-pager on data residency + SOC2/KMS?
Raj: I'll pull a token-level cost heatmap and per-route latency/cost by EOD. Will include month-over-month delta and a suggested batching/quantization knob that typically reduces cost 20-30%.
Maria: Alex specifically asked about SSO + where logs live. Priya, can you send the security pack + sample network diagram?
Priya: Yep — sending security pack + SOC2 attestation + KMS integration notes in thread in 10m. Also can offer a 1:1 onboarding session with our SE team if they do Dedicated trial.
Evan: Added a short perf snippet for their peak 95th pct latency; nothing alarming: 95p ~ 120ms. Sharing link: https://console.redwood.example/customers/pineforge/perf
Daniel: Scheduling renewal check-in for Tue 9am PT with Alex + their new PM. I'll include Raj and Priya.
Maria: Proposed win-back: 1 month of credits + Dedicated trial + onboarding at no charge. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Raj: Works for me. Include a recommended config: moderate batching + prefix cache on their high-frequency endpoints.
Priya: Agreed. Also offer a short eval script we can run to show latency/cost parity with their competitor for their top 3 flows.
Daniel: I'll lead the customer call and present the package. Maria — can you draft the outreach email?
Maria: Drafting now, will post here for review in 20m.
Raj: acked.
Priya: prepping PoC checklist.
Evan: Will monitor usage daily and flag any further drops.
Daniel: Thanks team — let's reconvene after the call. :thumbsup:
